    The Apex theme¶

    Apex is the default LuCI theme in CleanWRT. It is a dense, technical interface that stays readable on a phone. The source is in the luci-theme-apex repository.

    What it looks like¶

    • Dark by default, with an automatic light mode that follows your system, and a toggle in the top bar to force either one (your choice is remembered in the browser).
    • A sidebar for navigation and a drawer on small screens (a 390 px phone is a first-class target).
    • A teal accent colour and monospace type for technical values.
    • A dedicated login page, which also introduces AWvoice.
    • Card-style status widgets on Status → Overview for system, modem, memory and storage, instead of long tables.

    Screenshots¶

    The login page, dark and light:

    Dark Light

    About the screenshots

    The screenshots in this documentation were taken from a development preview of the interface (the same theme, pages and LED app as the firmware) running on a computer, with a simulated modem. Values such as the kernel, memory and storage differ on a real router.

    Switching themes¶

    Apex is selected on the first boot. To change it later:

    System → System → Language and Style → Design

    The stock Bootstrap theme stays installed as a fallback. Pages that use the card widgets fall back to the normal tables when another theme is active, so nothing is lost.

    Fonts¶

    The login page uses two self-hosted fonts, Inter and JetBrains Mono, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. No font is loaded from an outside server.

    Notes for developers¶

    The other parts of CleanWRT are on the Repositories page.

    The theme is an ordinary LuCI ucode theme: header.ut, footer.ut and the login page sysauth.ut under ucode/template/themes/apex/, a stylesheet with design tokens (--ax-* custom properties) and a small script for the sidebar. The status widgets are produced by patches to the pinned LuCI and QModem feeds (patches/feeds/), and only render while Apex is the active theme.
